messages:
maria: PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4282 — I addressed the review comments. Squashed the small fix commits, added a short smoke checklist in the README, and included sample logs for the failure case we saw earlier.

Tomer: i'll take a look today. any reason we shouldn't aim to canary this afternoon?

maria: no blocker on my side. i updated the canary notes (README) with steps and a fallback plan.

azu: can you paste the exact smoke commands here? easier to run them from the thread.

maria: sure — pasted below. quick run should take ~2m for the basic path.

```bash
# run smoke against staging cluster (uses local kubeconfig)
kubectl -n staging exec -it deploy/runtime-smoke -- /bin/sh -c "/app/bin/smoke -c smoke/quick.yaml"
# gather logs from the failing container
kubectl -n staging logs deploy/runtime --since=10m | grep -i backoff
```

maria: sample failure logs added to the PR, shows how the backoff loop hit a retry count then recovered.

deploy-bot: Canary reservation created: canary-slot-2026-03-20-16:30 UTC (owner: @maria) :white_check_mark:

Tomer: ran the quick smoke, everything passed locally. i saw one warn about a deprecated env var but not related to this change. LGTM.

azu: smoke ran for me too. i left one tiny nit inline (naming of the helper var). not blocking.

maria: thanks — fixed the helper var name and pushed. ptal when you have a sec.

Tomer: looks good. approving now.

azu: approved from me as well.

maria: great — assigning merge custodian to @ops for the reserved canary window. i'll be on call during the rollout in case we need to rollback. :hand:

Tomer: thanks! will monitor metrics during canary.

maria: final note in PR: if canary shows tokenization regressions, fallback plan is to route to model-variant v1.2 for 10m and open a follow-up.

Tomer: noted. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone :)
